create_ConfigScope: create a ConfigScope instance from a function to evaluate config with preset and fallback values
call_ConfigScope: call a ConfigScope with fixed preset and fallback dicts to produce a ConfigSummary
extract_function_body: extract the body code and line offset from a function using get_function_body
parse_config_comments: parse inline and preceding comments from a function into variable docs using get_config_comments
dedent_function_body: dedent a function body string by detecting and stripping the leading indentation
